about: Use-ChatqReplyState (src/phone.ps1) on data/replies.json: the file (none, json, text or hex bytes; a recipe makes the caps case) read under data/replies.lock, the change (the watcher's junk-only one: lastId and lastPolledAt; polled: lastPolledAt only; null: none) and Save-ChatqReplyState's write at now in a zone utcOffsetMinutes east, with reply.hours hours (0: from config). The answer is the saved file read back, its seen, refused and downSent sorted by name (hashtables, in no fixed order); for a recipe the alert, pick and seen names kept; or threw (locked, unreadable, invalid) and whether the file was left unchanged. repair marks a file chatqd refuses to write back (SPEC 2.2), its read and save checked one step lower.
